Interface Connections

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConnectionsImpl
public interface Connections
Client interface for managing Equinix Fabric connections. Provides operations for searching, retrieving, creating, and monitoring connections between Fabric endpoints.
Author:
ianjones

    • validate

      List<ValidateConnectionResult> validate(FilterPropertyList filter)
      Validates one or more prospective connections against the supplied filter criteria, for example a cloud provider authorization key or VLAN availability, without creating the connection. Mirrors the SDK's existing Fabric search filter shape.
      Parameters:
      filter - the validation filter criteria (auth key or VLAN)
      Returns:
      the list of connection specifications matching the validation request

    • getStatistics

      @Deprecated ConnectionStatistic getStatistics(String uuid, LocalDateTime startDateTime, LocalDateTime endDateTime, Side viewPoint)
      Deprecated.
      the /stats endpoint is deprecated by Equinix; use getMetrics(String, String, LocalDateTime, LocalDateTime) or Metrics.search(FilterPropertyList) instead.
      Retrieves bandwidth statistics for a connection over the specified time range, viewed from a specific side.

      UTC contract: LocalDateTime inputs are UTC wall clock (matching every timestamp the SDK returns); use LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC) for the current time.

      Parameters:
      uuid - the unique identifier of the connection
      startDateTime - the start of the statistics time range, as UTC wall clock
      endDateTime - the end of the statistics time range, as UTC wall clock
      viewPoint - the side (A-side or Z-side) from which to view the statistics
      Returns:
      the connection statistics for the specified time range and viewpoint

    • getMetrics

      List<Metric> getMetrics(String uuid, String name, LocalDateTime fromDateTime, LocalDateTime toDateTime)
      Retrieves metrics for a single connection over the specified time range. This is the non-deprecated replacement for getStatistics(String, LocalDateTime, LocalDateTime).

      UTC contract: LocalDateTime inputs are UTC wall clock (matching every timestamp the SDK returns); use LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC) for the current time.

      Parameters:
      uuid - the unique identifier of the connection
      name - the metric name to retrieve (for example equinix.fabric.connection.bandwidth_tx.usage), or null for all metrics
      fromDateTime - the start of the metrics time range, as UTC wall clock
      toDateTime - the end of the metrics time range, as UTC wall clock
      Returns:
      the list of metrics for the connection over the specified time range
